name: S19, Vilnius
notes:
CLAUDE STRUCTURE (22 Oct 2026): facility €4,946,000 (< €5m), 12% + 1.5% p.a., 8% fee withheld, 24 months bullet. Tranche 1 €3,146,000 at drawdown = refinancing SME Bank + SME Capital 3 (€2.75m) + fee. Fit-out €1.8m in 4 tranches of €450k matching the works (Jan/Mar/May/Jul 2027) against technical supervisor certificates; tranches 3-4 only after 6 presales are signed. Sponsor puts €300k cash in a pledged account at drawdown (funds the €149k contingency + buffer). Interest accrues and is paid from sale proceeds (no reserve). 100% of net sale proceeds to InRento (interest first) until repaid. Project management fee subordinated until InRento is repaid. Sales: 6 presales close at completion (Sep 2027), then 3 a month. Still needed: extra collateral or a new valuation – max LTV on the current appraisal is ~90%.

Conversion of administrative floors 3–4 at Savanorių pr. 19, Vilnius into 28 apartments (1,150.18 m² sellable per price list; appraisal area 1,293.16 m²). Borrower UAB Farerų salos (306963426), director Audrius Bagdonas.
Request (business plan): EUR 4.6m = 2.8m refinancing ('partial finish') + 1.8m full fit-out; interest 920k over 2 years (10%). Plan: sales 7,440,607 at 6,469 €/m² (discounted; official list 8,252,438 = 7,175 €/m²), costs 6,244,061, EBITDA 1,196,547 (16%). The plan's own break-even sheet: 'adjusted' prices 4,957 €/m² = 5,557,390 vs 5,520,000 owed to InRento.
Appraisal 26NT07-03 (UAB Nepriklausomų vertintojų biuras, Kristina Vysockaja): 125859/279191 share of administrative building 1099-4019-8018, market value EUR 5,625,250 at 15 Jul 2026 (comparative, 4,348.44 €/m² × 1,293.16 m²), for pledge purposes.
Financials H1 2026: the reported figures include manual adjustments of +3,758,583 (revaluation booked as interest income) and −521,342 (inventory). Before them: H1 2026 loss −210,330, equity −773,082, cash 13,877 (FY2025 loss −521,852). Debts 30 Jun 2026: SME Bank 2,000,000 (Euribor+4.5%, to 15 Sep 2027), SME Capital 3 750,000 (9.59%, due 30 Oct 2026), GEP Technik 66,975 (3%, related), Plytų pieva 11,900, UAB Savanorių 19 200,200 (repaid 12 Aug 2026).
INFERRED (check): drawdown 1 Nov 2026, 24-month bullet, fit-out in 4 tranches Jan–Jul 2027, 3% arrangement fee, 1.5% p.a. capital gain, interest paid from sale proceeds, sales Sep 2027 – Aug 2028, appraisal value split across units pro rata to price, project management 3% of revenue spread monthly, contingency 2% as Capex.
